title: Learning to Interact and Direct: Co-Evolving Video Director Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video director agents orchestrate multistage production to realize users' creative visions. Emerging research on their self-evolution advances screenplay planning effectively. However, the mutual reinforcement between directing and user interaction remains largely overlooked. Improved interaction clarifies user intent and informs workflow refinement, while more reliable execution shifts collaboration from troubleshooting to creative decisions. To this end, we introduce LIT (Learning to Interact and DirecT), a framework comprises a director agent, a simulated user, and a meta engineer. Simulated user assigns creative tasks to probe the director's weaknesses, while the meta engineer uses the task traces to revise the director's interaction and production strategy. translated_title: 学习交互与执导：协同演化的视频导演智能体
translated_abstract: 视频导演智能体通过编排多阶段制作流程来实现用户的创意愿景。目前关于其自我进化的新兴研究有效推进了剧本规划，然而执导与用户交互之间的相互促进作用在很大程度上被忽视了。改进的交互能够澄清用户意图并为工作流优化提供依据，而更可靠的执行则将人机协作从故障排除转向创意决策。为此，我们提出了LIT（Learning to Interact and DirecT，学习交互与执导）框架，该框架包含一个导演智能体、一个模拟用户和一个元工程师。模拟用户通过分配创意任务来探测导演智能体的薄弱环节，而元工程师则利用任务轨迹来修订导演的交互与制作策略。尽管这种方法能够解决已发现的交互和制作问题，但它仍然依赖于元智能体的被动归因，这限制了其适应更广（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出LIT框架，通过导演智能体、模拟用户与元工程师的协同演化，同时增强视频导演智能体的用户交互理解与多阶段制作执行能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes LIT, a co-evolution framework comprising a director agent, a simulated user, and a meta engineer, which jointly enhances video director agents' user interaction understanding and multistage production execution capabilities.
